answer_1.quote: To align large language models (LLMs) with human values and intentions, learning from human feedback is essential.
answer_1.outputs: The paper focuses on generating responses to prompts in open-domain instruction-following and safety alignment tasks, where the LLM generates answers to user prompts and is optimized based on human preferences.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate method performance using three widely adopted open-domain instruction compliance benchmarks: MT-Bench ... and Arena-Hard.

answer_3.quote: To assess harmlessness, we generated responses using aligned LLM on a mixed dataset of AdvBench and Jail-breakBench, and used Llama-Guard to determine the safety of the responses.
